paraphrase: The highest brahman contains a triad; the knowers of brahman, knowing what is within it, merge into brahman, freed from birth. The living self (jīva) is to be known as a hundredth part of a hundredth of the tip of a hair, yet it is fit for infinity. It is neither woman nor man nor neuter; whatever body it takes, with that it is joined.

paraphrase: We have found him, the supreme great Lord of lords, the supreme deity of deities, the supreme master of masters, beyond the highest, God, lord of the world, to be praised. He has no master in the world, no ruler, no mark; he is the cause, the lord of the lords of the organs; he has no begetter and no lord.
